resources.string: Set a device screen lock before making a thread private.

Require your screen lock to read this thread. At the top of Messages, pull down past the refresh distance to open private threads. Repeat to return. Hide this thread from search, notifications, screenshots and sharing shortcuts. Existing exports, provider history and independently connected devices keep their own copies.
Show this conversation in the inbox and allow new notifications and sharing shortcuts?
No private threads. Open a conversation and choose Make thread private.
